name: RM-70
armament: 40-tube 122 mm rocket launcher (Grad-compatible) with a 40-round automatic reload pack
protection: Armoured cab on the RM-70 (unarmoured on RM-70/85). Dimensions approximate. Game: armoured cab/hull immune to small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R and larger penetrate and can disable it; any launcher destroys it.
visual_notes: Tatra 813/815 8x8 truck: forward armoured cab, reload pack of 40 rockets directly behind the cab
40-tube launcher at the rear on a traverse mount
Searchlight on the cab roof; optional dozer blade on the front

colour_schemes.name: Ukrainian army green with field netting
